frontier.flow_boundary: secondary subloops 1 through 3, summed at each published timestamp
frontier.power_boundary: published compute_power_MW; IT submeter coverage and AC/DC equivalence not confirmed

v6.flow_boundary: internal water through the hot side of the plate HX, not lake intake or refrigerant
v6.power_boundary: delivered compute load on DC side; network/storage and AC conversion losses separate
v6.delta_boundary: hot reservoir at HX inlet minus internal HX outlet, not cold reservoir

reference_rules.scope: Analogous heat transport functions only; no matched site, metering boundary, fluid or operating window
reference_rules.sample_selection: All declared records; refuse invalid rows instead of silently discarding or resampling
reference_rules.flow_per_compute: Same-record mass flow divided by positive compute MW, kg/(s MW); report unweighted record min, median and max
reference_rules.temperature: Report each Frontier branch and the same-row mass-weighted temperature difference. V6 uses the actual hot-side plate HX drop
reference_rules.heat_diagnostic: Sum published Frontier branch heat or use V6 plate heat, then divide by own compute power. Ratios are not an identity or a pass test. Formula reproduction and archived whole-facility balance are separate
reference_rules.range_comparison: Descriptive position of the one V6 run's numeric range relative to the single Frontier day, no threshold, matched distribution or statistical inference
